appDescription: Reads the user's selected local driving practice records and explains their stored maneuver results and deductions.

function.name: GET_LAST_RESULT
function.description: Retrieves the most recent stored maneuver result within the user's selected local practice session.

sessionId.description: Optional identifier of the selected local practice session; omit when unknown.

maneuverType.description: Maneuver category to retrieve. PARKING includes all stored parking categories.

function.name: EXPLAIN_RESULT
function.description: Explains the saved score, deductions and evaluation holds of a result within the user's selected practice session.

sessionId.description: Optional identifier of the selected local practice session; omit when unknown.

resultId.description: Optional identifier of a stored maneuver result; omit to explain the latest stored maneuver.

maneuverType.description: Maneuver category to retrieve. PARKING includes all stored parking categories.

function.name: SUMMARIZE_SESSION
function.description: Summarizes observed strengths, repeated recorded deductions and unresolved evaluations in the selected local practice session.

sessionId.description: Optional identifier of the selected local practice session; omit when unknown.
